name: Goal24 Checkpoint 3 Lane A — Tauri Local Execution Broker Core
base_note: origin/dev/goal24-cli-skills, verified exact after git fetch --all --tags --prune; main is an ancestor
commit_sha_note: docs commit that records this checkpoint (the manifest itself is committed as the branch tip immediately after)

commits.message: feat(tauri): add restricted execution broker core
test(tauri): add broker security and lifecycle tests

ipc.note: execute_ipc_enabled is always false in CP3; no generic execute IPC is exposed

crate_internal: Broker::execute(plan, binding_id) — pub(crate), opened to IPC in CP4 with the GitHub adapter
Broker::cancel_execution(execution_id) — cancellation by broker-issued execution id only
ExecutionBinding trait — binding_id, adapter_id, capability_id, executable_candidates, build_argv, allowed_cwd_roots, derive_cwd, env_allowlist, output_limits

security_invariants: Approved semantic ExecutionPlan only; state=ready accepted once; state=executing rejected as replay guard
required_approval=true blocked with APPROVAL_ENFORCEMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE until Checkpoint 7; structural approval reference never treated as validation
No shell strings, no cmd /C, no powershell -Command, no sh -c / bash -c, no shell association
Executable, argv, cwd and env come exclusively from trusted compiled ExecutionBinding code; forbidden normalized_inputs keys rejected
No production bindings registered in CP3; test bindings are #[cfg(test)]-only
Plan identity fields (plan_id, capability_id, adapter_id, semver, expiry, timeout bounds) re-validated in Rust
No generic executor IPC; only read-only status surface

process_containment.windows: Job Object with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; spawn via CREATE_SUSPENDED, assign to job, resume primary thread; timeout/cancel/teardown terminates the whole job so grandchildren die
process_containment.unix_fallback: dedicated process group per child; SIGKILL to the whole group

executable_policy.source: trusted binding candidates only; plan can never supply a path
executable_policy.resolution: absolute path, canonicalize, regular file check; concrete absolute path used for spawn (no OS PATH search at spawn time)
executable_policy.identity: fingerprint records canonical path, size, mtime; re-verified immediately before spawn (EXECUTABLE_CHANGED on mismatch)
executable_policy.residual_risk: TOCTOU window between verify and CreateProcess; full hashing deliberately not forced in CP3

env_policy.mechanism: env_clear() then restore minimal base (SystemRoot, TEMP, TMP on Windows) plus binding allowlist
env_policy.path: PATH not inherited on Windows; executable is a resolved absolute path

cwd_policy.mechanism: binding derives candidate cwd; broker canonicalizes and requires equality with or descent from an allowlisted root

output_limits.clamp: binding limits clamped into [1, 1048576]; broker never raises the cap
output_limits.deadlock_prevention: reader threads keep draining after the cap; result reports truncated flags and total bytes seen

cancellation.mechanism: active-execution registry maps execution_id to cancel token; terminate + wait

tests.child_fixture: test binary itself via std::env::current_exe() + #[cfg(test)]-only child protocol; no cmd.exe/powershell/sh/bash fixtures

result.note: ignored test is the child-protocol entry spawned explicitly by parent tests

verification.cargo_check: PASS (only pre-existing clipboard.rs dead-code warning from base)
verification.cargo_clippy_all_targets: PASS (only pre-existing base warnings; none in execution_broker)
verification.verify_controlled: PASS; snapshot regenerated for Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, commands.rs, main.rs and committed

cargo_audit.note: verified by auditing the base Cargo.lock; only new lock entry is libc (unix-only); windows 0.52 features extended, no new crates

known_residual_risks: TOCTOU window between pre-spawn fingerprint check and CreateProcess (metadata fingerprint, not full hash)
libtest child harness consumes leading --flag-style payload args; flag-like argv values verified at build_argv unit level
unix process-group containment is fallback-only and not exercised on this Windows host
secret stripping covers broker child environment only; other same-user surfaces are out of CP3 scope
production execute IPC opens in CP4 with the GitHub adapter

environment.policy: D: first, then existing C:; new installs only under D:\environment
